entities.title: TypeScript library source
entities.summary: The source of @utv/core: the typed layer (0.3) over the JSON-level everyday API (0.2), the text form, validation (0.1) and native interop.
entities.purpose: Holds every module the package compiles from. index.ts is the one entry point. values.ts, outcome.ts and context.ts are the typed layer; builders.ts, iso.ts, text.ts, ops.ts, zones.ts and native.ts the JSON layer; json.ts, structural.ts and civil.ts validation; result.ts the result envelope; internal.ts and rational.ts the shared readers, writers and exact numbers.
boundaries: Every typed operation calls the JSON layer underneath, so both layers give the same answers as the shared fixtures.
No runtime dependencies: the only Node built-in is node:fs readFileSync, for the rule file a caller names (declared in node.d.ts so no @types/node is needed).
Never reads the clock, the host's time zone or tz database, or its locale; test/native.test.ts checks the sources for it.
The contracts it implements are defined in docs/ and spec/; the rule data it is given is the caller's.
